# Third-party assets

No third-party model, animation, audio, or weapon binary is currently present in this project checkout.

The files `Quaternius/AnimatedMen_LICENSE_CC0.txt` and `Quaternius/Cars_LICENSE_CC0.txt` are license placeholders only; the corresponding assets are not included.

The editor integration can detect compatible models after the user imports them legally. Recommended optional free packages are listed in `README_FIRST.txt`. Unity Asset Store content remains governed by the Unity Asset Store EULA and is not redistributed with this project.

Any asset added later must record its exact source URL, author, downloaded version/date, and license in this file before distribution.
